title: Ranjan Mistry
text:
Ranjan Mistry (Hindi: रंजन मिस्त्री ) is an Indian Social entrepreneur and Think Tank of Bihar.

 Early life and education 
Ranjan Mistry (Hindi: रंजन मिस्त्री ) was born on 14 March 1996 in Patna, Bihar, India, to Mr. Gopal Sharma and Mrs. Sudama Devi and raised in a lower-middle-class family.
